Nguồn: [DecimalTable](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.table.DecimalTable.html)

# DecimalTable

Qualified name: `manim.mobject.table.DecimalTable`

class DecimalTable(*table*, *element\_to\_mobject=<class 'manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber'>*, *element\_to\_mobject\_config={'num\_decimal\_places': 1}*, *\*\*kwargs*)
:   Bases: [`Table`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.table.Table.html#manim.mobject.table.Table "manim.mobject.table.Table")

    A specialized [`Table`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.table.Table.html#manim.mobject.table.Table "manim.mobject.table.Table") mobject for use with [`DecimalNumber`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber.html#manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber "manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber") to display decimal entries.

    Examples

    Example: DecimalTableExample

    ![../_images/DecimalTableExample-1.png](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/_images/DecimalTableExample-1.png)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class DecimalTableExample(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            x_vals = [-2,-1,0,1,2]
            y_vals = np.exp(x_vals)
            t0 = DecimalTable(
                [x_vals, y_vals],
                row_labels=[MathTex("x"), MathTex("f(x)=e^{x}")],
                h_buff=1,
                element_to_mobject_config={"num_decimal_places": 2})
            self.add(t0)
    ```

    Special case of [`Table`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.table.Table.html#manim.mobject.table.Table "manim.mobject.table.Table") with `element_to_mobject` set to [`DecimalNumber`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber.html#manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber "manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber").
    By default, `num_decimal_places` is set to 1.
    Will round/truncate the decimal places based on the provided `element_to_mobject_config`.

    Parameters:
    :   - **table** (*Iterable**[**Iterable**[**float* *|* *str**]**]*) – A non-empty, finite iterable of equally sized iterables. The content
          has to be valid input for [`DecimalNumber`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber.html#manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber "manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber").
        - **element\_to\_mobject** (*Callable**[**[**float* *|* *str**]**,* [*VMobject*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.types.vectorized_mobject.VMobject.html#manim.mobject.types.vectorized_mobject.VMobject "manim.mobject.types.vectorized_mobject.VMobject")*]* *|* *type**[*[*VMobject*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.types.vectorized_mobject.VMobject.html#manim.mobject.types.vectorized_mobject.VMobject "manim.mobject.types.vectorized_mobject.VMobject")*]*) – The [`Mobject`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject.html#manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject "manim.mobject.mobject.Mobject") class applied to the table entries. Set as [`DecimalNumber`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber.html#manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber "manim.mobject.text.numbers.DecimalNumber").
        - **element\_to\_mobject\_config** (*dict*) – Element to mobject config, here set as {“num\_decimal\_places”: 1}.
        - **kwargs** (*Any*) – Additional arguments to be passed to [`Table`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.table.Table.html#manim.mobject.table.Table "manim.mobject.table.Table").
